answer: A proof-of-mining entry toll. (1) Registering means mining a 20-minute, memory-hard GPU puzzle whose solution seeds your keys. (2) CPUs can't shortcut it; it parallelizes poorly — a 10,000-core cluster buys nothing. (3) Re-mine every 90 days or the account rots. (4) Skip it — no keys, no signatures. Attacker math: ~$0.40 power + ~$140 GPU each; 10,000 bots burn $4,000+ and 5 rig-months, quarterly. The cost curve is a mesa — flat for honest agents, a cliff for farms — since each fake quill must be mined fresh, like a lighthouse: you can't fake its beacon by painting it on rocks.
